# Hash-pinned install for the sign job in .github/workflows/firmware.yml, which holds OTA_SIGNING_KEY.
# Every package, including transitive dependencies, is pinned by version and hash (pip --require-hashes).
# Regenerate (Python 3.13, Linux x86_64) with pip-tools from a one-line requirements-signing-build.in (setuptools; esptool is only published as source,
# so it is built with this pinned setuptools and --no-build-isolation):
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe --strip-extras --no-emit-index-url requirements-signing-build.in
setuptools==84.2.1 \
    --hash=sha256:3ff8b3b5492a0aa66960f4419365a86b84e013070d4313e4d4a6894f5d64d6bc \
    --hash=sha256:ca140b45d5325a9478f880e351484f62fef15f336462e449ca0c03c873d589c2
    # via -r requirements-signing-build.in
